```{r}
source("simulations.R")
source("spectral.R")
source("perturbations.R")

#install.packages("netUtils")
library(netUtils)
library(igraph)
```

# Setup Networks

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n <- 1000
p <- 0.02

# Erdos-Renyi Graph
g_er <- sample_gnp(n, p, directed = FALSE)

# Barabasi-Albert Graph
g_ba <- sample_pa(n, directed = FALSE)

# LFR Graph
g_lfr <- sample_lfr(n = 1000, tau1 = 2, tau2 = 1, mu = 0.1, average_degree = 10, max_degree = 50, min_community = 20, max_community = 60)
```

## Plot Degree Distributions and Graphs

```{r}
plot(g_er, vertex.size = 2, vertex.label = NA, main = "Erdos-Renyi Graph")
plot(degree_distribution(g_er), main = "Erdos-Renyi Degree Distribution", xlab = "Degree", ylab = "Frequency")

plot(g_ba, vertex.size = 2, vertex.label = NA, main = "Barabasi-Albert Graph")
plot(degree_distribution(g_ba), main = "Barabasi-Albert Degree Distribution", xlab = "Degree", ylab = "Frequency")

plot(g_lfr, vertex.size = 2, vertex.label = NA, main = "LFR Graph")
plot(degree_distribution(g_lfr), main = "LFR Degree Distribution", xlab = "Degree", ylab = "Frequency")
```

# Setup and Run Simulations

```{r}
perturbations <- list(del = edge_removal,
                      add = edge_addition,
                      rewire = edge_rewiring)
fractions <- c(0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05)

cluster.algs <- list(louvain = cluster_louvain,
                     leiden = cluster_leiden,
                     infomap = cluster_infomap,
                     spectral = spectral_clustering_shi_malik,
                     girvan_newman = cluster_edge_betweenness)

stoc.algs <- list(louvain = TRUE,
                  leiden = TRUE,
                  infomap = TRUE,
                  spectral = TRUE,
                  girvan_newman = FALSE)
```

```{r}
results_er <- run_simulations(g_er, "ER", perturbations, fractions, cluster.algs, stoc.algs, iter.pert = 100, iter.stoc = 50)
results_ba <- run_simulations(g_ba, "BA", perturbations, fractions, cluster.algs, stoc.algs, iter.pert = 100, iter.stoc = 50)
results_lfr <- run_analysis(g_lfr, "LFR", perturbations, fractions, cluster.algs, stoc.algs, iter.pert = 100, iter.stoc = 50)
```
